WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        legacy_code,
        trim(legacy_code, ' ') AS code_trimmed
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }}
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        legacy_code,
        code_trimmed,
        CASE
            WHEN code_trimmed = '' THEN 0
            WHEN regexp_matches(code_trimmed, '^[+-]?[0-9]+$') THEN TRY_CAST(code_trimmed AS INTEGER)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS legacy_code_num
    FROM src
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    legacy_code,
    legacy_code_num,
    CASE WHEN legacy_code_num IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
FROM parsed

        customer_id,
        legacy_code,
        trim(legacy_code) AS code_trimmed
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }}
),
checked AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        legacy_code,
        code_trimmed,
        regexp_matches(code_trimmed, '^[+-]?[0-9]+$') AS is_int_text
    FROM src
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    legacy_code,
    CASE WHEN is_int_text THEN TRY_CAST(code_trimmed AS INTEGER) END AS legacy_code_num,
    CASE WHEN is_int_text AND TRY_CAST(code_trimmed AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS invalid
FROM checked

explanation: This procedure rebuilds a diagnostic table from the customers table. For each customer it keeps the raw legacy code, attempts to convert that code to an integer, and flags whether the conversion failed. Rows where the code is not a valid integer get `invalid = 1` and a NULL numeric value.
